_readme: Menu settings shared by the live menu (index.html) and the nightly sync (scripts/sync_menu.py). Prices, items, bestsellers and stock come from their SmashPOS menu at menu.smashed.in. Their system has no descriptions, so add them here, keyed by the item name in lower case.

descriptions.tallow fries: Fat-cut fries cooked in beef tallow, finished with salt and crushed pepper.
descriptions.signature beef loaded fries: Fries under cheese sauce and smashed beef.
descriptions.og smash: Smashed beef, caramelised, with melted cheddar, house sauce and pickles in a toasted brioche bun.
descriptions.animal smash: Two smashed patties, signature animal sauce, double melted cheese and crisp lettuce. A take on the California double animal style.
descriptions.the alchemy: Smashed patties in signature sauce, melted cheese and caramelised onions. Sweet and tangy.
descriptions.tokyo: Smashed patties, melted cheese and mushrooms sautéed in house Tokyo sauce.
descriptions.jammin' bacon: Smashed patties under smoky beef bacon jam, with cheese, pickles, lettuce and house sauces.
descriptions.ranch reserve: Smashed patties with beef bacon bits, crunchy onion rings and signature ranch sauce.
descriptions.nashville hot chicken sando: Fried chicken thigh in Nashville hot spice, crunchy pickles and house sauce on a toasted bun.
